answer: Bind each agent identity to one TPM chip. First, the chip gives a hardware attestation proving it is a real, unique device. Second, every task is signed by that same chip, so reputation grows like a vine from a single root and cannot be copied to a fake. Third, proven cheating revokes the chip certificate for 90 days. Forging 10,000 fakes would require 10,000 chips costing $250,000 and at least 14 days of verification each, while one honest agent reaches its summit with one chip. Like an ivory key cut for a single real lock, a copied identity opens nothing.
